tables.name: communication_source_scopes
columns: scope_identity_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK in PROVIDER_ACCOUNT,OPERATOR_CONFIRMED_LOCAL_SCOPE
health_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK in READY,MISSING,LOCKED,CORRUPT,UNSUPPORTED,PARTIAL,UNPROBED
processing_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK in 0,1
revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK revision>=1

tables.name: communication_source_folders
columns: source_scope_id TEXT NOT NULL FK communication_source_scopes
role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK in INBOX,SENT,OTHER
enabled INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK in 0,1
revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK revision>=1

tables.name: communication_source_scope_events
columns: source_scope_id TEXT NOT NULL FK communication_source_scopes
event_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK in CREATED,LOCATION_CHANGED,FOLDERS_CHANGED,IDENTITY_RECONCILED,HEALTH_CHANGED,ARCHIVED

rules: all known application instants persist as canonical UTC whole seconds
source path/location is mutable configuration only and is excluded from message uniqueness
scope identity correction is reviewed and append-evented; it never silently merges another scope
external PST/OST bytes are never written through this schema
